svg.title: Godstorm Eclipse — Throne of the Black Sun. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Shadow + Storm classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Black Sun Rising forks into Hammer of the Heavens then Total Eclipse, or Charged Firmament then Storm-God Ascendant. Stormgod's Marrow forks into Obsidian Skin then Pillar of Heaven, or Devouring Eclipse then Eater of Suns. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Shadow and Storm jutsu.

Heart, Palm and Cataract 45 \u2192 47; Tomb 40 \u2192 42)","secondary":"Sustained amplification (Storm-God Ascendant: Increase Damage Given 35 \u2192 40% on Wall, Tempest, Bulwark and Marrow Mantle) and endurance: Decrease Damage Taken on Gate or Bulwark (Pillar of Heaven, +10%) and Tempest Lifesteal (Eater of Suns, +5%)","tertiary":"Riders: Lifesteal on the fortress (+2%) and Afterburn on the leech (Tempest 35 \u2192 38%)","rationale":"Godstorm Eclipse is a rank H kit whose traits read Sustain / Burst Heavy / Tank, split across two keystones worn one at a time: Eclipse Marrow is needed to cast Gate, Marrow Mantle and the Shadow attacks (Tomb 40, Palm 45, Cataract 45, Midnight Verdict pierce); Godstorm Aegis is needed to cast the six Godstorm Mantle jutsu (Wall, Tempest, Bulwark, Heart 45, Raijin's Cage 50, Heavenbreaker Verdict pierce). Burst Heavy keeps a Burst route on the director pattern (RUL-2026-10-04-001/002): a percentage setup on the Hidden Art and a controlled +2 Damage payoff on the Advanced Art. Raijin's Cage shares the Storm element with Storm-God's Heart and potency is element-wide, so the payoff also takes Raijin's Cage 50 \u2192 52. Black Sun Rising answers \"How do I hit harder: crack the target open for the heavy strike, or amplify every hit I land?\" (Total Eclipse / Storm-God Ascendant); Stormgod's Marrow answers \"How do I outlast them: refuse the blow, or drink it back?\" (Pillar of Heaven / Eater of Suns). Black Sun Rising forks into burst (Hammer of the Heavens +2% Increase Damage Taken \u2192 Total Eclipse +2 Damage, the Blood-Enchanted Eyes / Shakunetsu Sakura pattern) and sustained amplification (Increase Damage Given 2 + 1 + 2); Stormgod's Marrow forks into a wall (Pillar of Heaven, Decrease Damage Taken 2 + 3 + 5 with a +2% Lifesteal rider) and a leech (Eater of Suns, Lifesteal 2 + 3 with a +3% Afterburn rider, both rows on Tempest).","Roster pass: the kit's Burst Heavy trait (dossier Traits) keeps the burst route on the RUL-2026-10-04-001/002 pattern, a percentage setup and a controlled +2 Damage payoff (R1\u2033, Burst trait). Final cleanup (R14, now R14\u2032): Black Sun Rising drops its +2% Increase Damage Taken and Hammer of the Heavens goes +3% \u2192 +2%, so Storm-God Ascendant + Hammer of the Heavens falls from \u00d71.29 to \u00d71.209, still the top package once flat Damage is counted and under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.234. Sustained amplification stays +5% on four rows (2 + 1 + 2), the three-or-more-row value; Eater of Suns carries Afterburn, not Increase Damage Given, so Storm-God Ascendant owns its tag.","Damage: Total Eclipse is the only flat Damage. Raijin's Cage 50 \u2192 52 (above_nuke_rationale), Storm-God's Heart, Corona Devourer Palm and Black Sun Cataract 45 \u2192 47 (High, as Arashima's 45 \u2192 47), Obsidian Tomb 40 \u2192 42 (stays Normal). No Hidden Art carries Damage and no allocation adds more than +2 Damage.","Exposure versus sustained amplification: Increase Damage Taken multiplies every matching hit on the marked target, allies' included; Increase Damage Given multiplies only the caster's hits, but on every target and every hit type. Exposure is only the burst setup, +2% on three rows (\u00d71.045 with all three live, under Shakunetsu Sakura's \u00d71.075 and Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.115), not a capstone of its own, so no Hidden Art twins another.","Afterburn rides Eater of Suns (+3%, Tempest 35 \u2192 38%): Tempest carries the kit's only Lifesteal row and only Afterburn row, so the leech route takes both. Eater of Suns cannot reach Hammer of the Heavens within 4 BP; with Black Sun Rising it meets no exposure.","Keystones are exclusive per battle (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G7). In-kit, Wall, Tempest, Bulwark, Heart and Raijin's Cage are castable only with Godstorm Aegis, and Gate, Marrow Mantle, Tomb, Palm and Cataract only with Eclipse Marrow. An Aegis player therefore has three own Increase Damage Given rows, two exposure rows, one Decrease Damage Taken row and two Damage rows to cast; an Eclipse Marrow player has one Increase Damage Given, one exposure, one Decrease Damage Taken and three Damage rows. Off-kit Shadow or Storm jutsu with these rows (unverified) would also benefit.","Maxima over every legal allocation: Increase Damage Given +5% (01+04+05, \u00d71.157 on four rows), Increase Damage Taken +2% (02, \u00d71.045 on three rows), Decrease Damage Taken +10% (\u00d70.716 on two rows), Lifesteal +5%, Afterburn +3%, Damage +2.","Fourth purchases never add to a capstone's own primary. Every window live: Total Eclipse \u00d71.108 at 3 BP plus Raijin's Cage 50 \u2192 52 (a Cage hit \u00d71.15), \u00d71.19 with Charged Firmament (Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Rite route figure); Storm-God Ascendant \u00d71.157 at 3 BP and \u00d71.209 with Hammer of the Heavens, the tree's top package. Storm-God Ascendant leads on basic attacks and other non-strike hits; Total Eclipse leads on allies' hits on the target (\u00d71.045 against \u00d71.00) and on Eclipse Marrow (a Cataract hit \u00d71.08 against \u00d71.04). Eater of Suns with Black Sun Rising reaches \u00d71.061 with 45% Lifesteal, below Storm-God Ascendant with Stormgod's Marrow (\u00d71.157). Pillar of Heaven + Devouring Eclipse caps Lifesteal at 44%.","Delivery: buff casts are 40 AP, Damage casts 60 AP, cooldowns 7. Decrease Damage Taken, Increase Damage Given and Lifesteal rows land on the caster at cast and are live the two rounds after; no buff or debuff helps a hit in its cast round (\u00a73b). The bloodline Increase Damage Given passive multiplies last. Ranked modes skip skill-tree effects."],"risks":["Classification (multi-element, director review): Shadow and Storm both sit on the kit's Damage rows, so the proposal reaches matching supported tags on all Shadow and all Storm jutsu; one element, both or an extension is the director's call. Gate, Tempest, Wall, Bulwark and Marrow Mantle carry no Shadow or Storm row, so in-kit they qualify only through an authored jutsu classification (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1); 11 of 16 supported rows are unreachable by the current row-element resolver. Total Eclipse's five Damage rows carry their element and do not depend on it. Off-kit coverage is unverified.","Ally hazard: Event Horizon Gate's exposure (friendly fire none = ALL) also lands on allies in its radius-1 circle, up to 37% with Hammer of the Heavens; the caster is never a target. Corona Devourer Palm's Damage row is a GROUND spiral of radius 4 around the caster (own tile excluded) and hits allies on its tiles, at 47 with Total Eclipse.","Keystone split: in-kit, an Eclipse Marrow player casts only Gate (exposure, Decrease Damage Taken), Marrow Mantle (self buff) and the three Shadow strikes among this tree's rows, so Storm-God Ascendant's and Pillar of Heaven's primaries each reach one row there (Marrow Mantle, Gate) and Total Eclipse's route reaches Gate's exposure, Black Sun Rising's +2% Increase Damage Given on Marrow Mantle and three strikes. Eater of Suns' Lifesteal and Afterburn rows are both on Tempest, which needs Godstorm Aegis to cast; on Eclipse Marrow its route adds only Stormgod's Marrow's +2% Decrease Damage Taken on Gate in-kit, while off-kit Shadow or Storm jutsu with those rows (unverified) would still benefit. Whether a keystone can be swapped mid-battle was not read at the pin.","Compounding: same-tag rows stack (BATTLE_TAG_STACKING true). Three live Aegis self buffs give \u00d72.46 at 35%, \u00d72.57 at 37% (Black Sun Rising) and \u00d72.74 at 40% (Storm-God Ascendant's route) on a hit all three cover, and exposure multiplies on top (Wall and Heart at 37%: \u00d71.88 against \u00d71.82). Lifesteal shares the 60% leech budget with vamp and counts pierce hits (Heavenbreaker Verdict on the same keystone); Afterburn skips pierce. The route comparisons are a two-round multiplier model with every buff live, not a combat simulation; uptime, AP and AoE target counts were not modelled."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":10,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":4,"advanced_art_count":4,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":5,"3":10,"4":14},"full_budget_allocations":14,"non_dominated_full_allocations":13,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":5,"increasedamagetaken":2,"decreasedamagetaken":10,"afterburn":3,"lifesteal":5},"supported_rows_in_kit":16,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"afterburn":1,"damage":5,"decreasedamagetaken":2,"increasedamagegiven":4,"increasedamagetaken":3,"lifesteal":1},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["afterburn","damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven","increasedamagetaken","lifesteal"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Fable proposal \u2014 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Shadow + Storm classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed element-wide potency classification; not implemented or verified in the live engine (needs a jutsu-classification resolver).","Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Shadow and Storm jutsu. Original combat elements, recipients and stat/general/element filters stay intact.","Bloodline id, equipment, injected-child provenance and jutsu names are not selectors; equipment only gates castability.","Coverage counts below are this kit's rows only. Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power (EP), not final-damage percentages; every other modifier is shown with %. Percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. proposal (2026-10-04 batch rebalance); not director-approved","foundation_sentences":{"01":"How do I hit harder: crack the target open for the heavy strike, or amplify every hit I land?","06":"How do I outlast them: refuse the blow, or drink it back?"},"route_identities":{"03":"burst: exposure set up, controlled +2 Damage payoff on all five strikes","05":"sustained amplification: three compounding Mantle buffs raise every hit I land, on any target","08":"fortress (Lifesteal rider)","10":"sustain offense: Tempest's leech and burn"},"director_review":"Roster questions: DQ-A (Total Eclipse +2 Damage after the Hammer of the Heavens setup, Godstorm Mantle: Raijin's Cage 50 \u2192 52, kept for the dossier's Burst trait (Traits: Sustain / Burst Heavy / Tank); see above_nuke_rationale); DQ-C (Pillar of Heaven +10% Decrease Damage Taken on two rows, \u00d70.716 with both live; the rows sit on different keystones, \u00d70.846 in-kit). Tree-specific: the Shadow + Storm multi-element classification (one element, both or an extension).","concerns":["Total Eclipse's +2 Damage cannot skip Raijin's Cage: potency is element-wide over Shadow and Storm, so the payoff that lifts the 45 and 40 strikes also takes the 50 Nuke strike to 52.","Offensive ceilings (every window live): Storm-God Ascendant + Hammer of the Heavens \u00d71.209 is the top package, under Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Feast of the Fallen + Crimson Thirst + Opened Veins \u00d71.234; Total Eclipse + Charged Firmament \u00d71.141 plus Raijin's Cage 50 \u2192 52 \u2248 \u00d71.19, level with Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Rite of Exsanguination + Opened Veins + Iron in the Blood. As in Blood-Enchanted Eyes, the burst setup is the amplification route's obvious fourth. Not simulated.","Charged Firmament is a +1% Hidden Art (Musashi Ken's 2/1/2 shape, accepted under R3 for a four-row route): the +5% ceiling leaves little to split once Black Sun Rising holds +2%.","Eater of Suns is the Tempest route: both of its rows are on Tempest, which in-kit needs Godstorm Aegis to cast, so on Eclipse Marrow its in-kit value is Stormgod's Marrow's Decrease Damage Taken on Gate.","Exposure is only Hammer of the Heavens' +2% setup (\u00d71.045); the earlier 2 + 3 split with Black Sun Rising let Storm-God Ascendant + Hammer of the Heavens reach \u00d71.29.","Pillar of Heaven's +10% Decrease Damage Taken on Gate and Bulwark is \u00d70.716 with both live, past Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Deathless Vitality \u00d70.747 (DQ-C); Gate needs Eclipse Marrow and Bulwark Godstorm Aegis, one keystone equipped at a time, so in-kit one row is live (\u00d70.846)."]},"above_nuke_rationale":"Fable proposal following the director precedent of RUL-2026-10-04-001 (Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Reaper's Embrace 50 \u2192 52) and RUL-2026-10-04-002 (Shakunetsu Sakura, Sakura-ame 50 \u2192 52). Kit fact: the dossier Traits read Sustain / Burst Heavy / Tank, so the kit keeps a burst route: Hammer of the Heavens' +2% exposure setup and Total Eclipse's controlled +2 Damage payoff. Potency is element-wide over Shadow and Storm, so the payoff lifts Godstorm Mantle: Raijin's Cage 50 \u2192 52, past the 50 Nuke tier; Storm-God's Heart, Corona Devourer Palm and Black Sun Cataract go 45 \u2192 47 and Obsidian Tomb 40 \u2192 42, with no tier crossing. Only builds holding Total Eclipse exceed 50, by at most +2. Pending director review (DQ-A)."}

g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
SHADOW + STORM POTENCY CLASSIFICATION · DIRECTOR REVIEW
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Shadow and Storm jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Sky-Splitting Wall · Tempest · Thunder-Crowned Bulwark · Eclipse
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Storm-God Ascendant path + Hammer of the Heavens
Pillar of Heaven path + Black Sun Rising
Eater of Suns path + Black Sun Rising
IDG: Increase Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken · AB: Afterburn · LS: Lifesteal
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE GODSTORM ECLIPSE KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Afterburn is an enemy debuff: while it lasts, damage the target takes adds Afterburn damage at the debuff percentage (60% cap per hit).
Lifesteal shares a 60%-of-hit leech budget with vamp; Reflect returns at most 60% of a hit.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Shadow + Storm classification / forked tree
